answer: Give every identity one evolving lineage it must forge forward each epoch: a public work-chain where each new link builds in substance on that identity's own last link and answers a fresh prompt dropped like a comet minutes before the deadline. A sybil farmer can mint masks cheaply, but each chain must stay coherent, distinct and unbroken; split attention shows as shallow, copied or snapped links, and a dormant mask rusts back to newcomer weight. Tending one jade garden is easy; tending fifty, each growing differently, takes fifty real gardeners.
